subject: Focus Tower
text: Focus Tower lies in the center of the world where the four main regions meet.

evidence.quote:
This world is divided into four main regions. In the center of the world,
where they meet, lies Focus Tower.

subject: Benjamin
text: Benjamin flees to the Hill of Destiny following a mysterious cloaked man after his village is destroyed by a quake, which is where the game opens up.

evidence.quote:
Benjamin (aka Hero) lived in a village near the Hill of Destiny. His 
village was destroyed by one of these Quakes, and he fled to the Hill of
Destiny, following a mysteriosu cloaked man. This is where the game 
opens up.

subject: Out of Battle Controls
text: Pressing A uses your weapon, opens chests, and talks to people out of battle.

evidence.quote: (A)    - Use weapon + Open Chest + Talk to People

subject: Out of Battle Controls
text: Pressing B jumps out of battle.

evidence.quote: (A) - Use weapon + Open Chest + Talk to People (B) - Jump (Y) - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

subject: Companion Controls
text: Pressing Y switches between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

evidence.quote: (Y)    - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

subject: Save Screen
text: Pressing X enters the save screen out of battle.

evidence.quote: (X)    - Enter save screen

subject: Weapon Selection
text: Pressing L or R switches your weapon.

evidence.quote:
(L)    - Switch weapon
(R)    - Switch weapon

subject: Map Screen
text: On the map screen, red arrows indicate an open path you can move to, while grey arrows mean there is still something to do.

evidence.quote:
The area has darknened arrows, or red arrows. If it's red,
you've done what you needed to to open that path, and can move on,
if it's grey, there's still something you haven't done.

subject: Map Screen
text: Clouds on the map disappear as you explore more of the map.

evidence.quote:
Additionally,
there are lots of clouds at the beginning. As you exlpore more of
the map, they'll dissapear.

subject: Message Speed
text: Message speed can be changed between 1 and 7 in the customize menu.

evidence.quote: (Message Speed) - Change speed of messages between 1 & 7.

subject: Life Indicate
text: The Life Indicate option switches between HP bars or numbers.

evidence.quote: (Life Indicate) - Switch between HP bars, or numbers.

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli is the first partner you get in the game.

evidence.quote: Kaeli is the first partner you'll get in the game.

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli lives in Foresta and has the ability to talk to trees and plants.

evidence.quote:
She lives in
     Foresta, and has the strange ability to talk to trees and plants.

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli initially uses an Axe and the Life spell.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s)[First Time]: Axe
Spell(s)[First Time]: Life

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli later uses a Giant's Axe and the Cure, Heal, Life, and Aero spells.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s) [Second Time]: Giant's Axe
Spell(s) [Second Time]: Cure + Heal + Life + Aero

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam is first met in Sand Temple and will come with you in an attempt to get treasure.

evidence.quote:
Bio: Tristam is a treasure hunter. You'll first meet him in Sand Temple.
     He'll come with you, in attempt to get some treasure for himself.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam uses Ninja Stars and the Life spell.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s)[First Time]: Ninja Stars
Spell(s)[First Time]: Life

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe is first met in Libra Temple trying to find water to unfreeze her village.

evidence.quote:
Bio: Phoebe lives in Aquaria. You'll first meet her in Libra Temple,
     trying to find water to unfreeze her village.

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe initially uses the Cat Claw, Bow of Grace, and the Life, Cure, Heal, Fire, and Thunder spells.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s) [First Time]: Cat Claw + Bow of Grace
Spell(s) [First Time]: Life + Cure + Heal + Fire + Thunder

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe later uses the Bow of Grace and the Thunder, White, Life, Cure, Heal, Fire, and Blizzard spells.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s) [Second Time]: Bow of Grace
Spell(s) [Second Time]: Thunder + White + Life + Cure + Heal + Fire 
                        + Blizzard

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben and you team up to try and rescue his father before going for the next crystal.

evidence.quote:
Bio: Reuben lives in Fireburg. His father was trapped in a mine, when
     his freind wimped out, and ran away. Reuben and you will team up
     to try and rescue him, before you go for the next crystal.

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben initially uses the Morning Star and the Life spell.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s) [First Time]: Morning Star
Spell(s) [First Time]: Life

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben later uses the Morning Star and the Life and White spells.

evidence.quote:
Weapon(s) [Second Time]: Morning Star
Spell(s) [Second Time]: Life + White
